intro.title: Sebɛa iqrunen deg wul n Lebḥer Ageraɣlan
intro.text: Seg users-ines n tmucuha s ufus n tgellidt Didun armi d tikli tarusant n Hanibal ger yidurar n Alpes, Qarṭaǧ tella-d d yiwet seg idlisen imeqqranen n tallit taqburt : tamdint n yibeḥriyen, n yinazzaɛen akked yimezraɛen, d tamesmixert n Ṛuma ugar n lqern.
nums.0.text: iseggasen seg users (814) armi d tṭefi n Ṛuma (146 send Ɛisa)
nums.1.text: imenɣan ipuniyen mgal Ṛuma, i tɛasa n Lebḥer Ageraɣlan
nums.2.text: lbabura n umenɣi ssersent deg lmirsa ajemmuri, ul n lmiraṣi i sin
nums.3.text: Amḍiq n tqedmiwin n Qarṭaǧ yettwajerb ɣer UNESCO
civ.title: Idles ur yettwaf ara
civ.aside: Ugar n sebɛa iqrunen n umezruy, n ttjara d tenyafin.
civ.items.0.title: Imɛallmen n lebḥer
civ.items.0.text: Agraw n lbabura ugar n yezmer di Lebḥer Ageraɣlan Lɣarbi, ixeddem ibriden seg Sicile armi d Spanya d wayen i yellan agemma n tɣuyin n Hercule. Lmirsa ajemmuri — ass-a d agelmim — yesɛa 220 n lbabura n umenɣi.
civ.items.1.title: Imnayen n tmucuha
civ.items.1.text: Hanibal Barka, yiwen seg yimusnawen n umenɣi imeqqranen n umezruy, yezger idurar n Alpes s ilfilen-is n umenɣi. Kan mazal-itt tettwazreɛ deg tkadimiyin tiɛeskriyin.
civ.items.2.title: Tagelda n ttjara
civ.items.2.alt: Tirgin n uzemmur n Ras Tib (Cap Bon)
civ.items.2.text: Seg Bretagne armi d Afrika n Lɣarb, acebbub-is n ttjara yesnulfa-d tadamsa taqburt. Tirgin n uzemmur n Ras Tib ssecbaɛent yakan Lebḥer Ageraɣlan.

note.title: Qarṭaǧ werǧin tettwakkes seg tkarḍa
note.text: Lmelḥ yettwazerrɛen ɣef lxrab d tamacahut tatrart : ulac aɣbalu aqdim i t-id-ibedren. Tettwaṭṭef, tettwarɣa deg 146 send Ɛisa, tamdint-nni tettwales tebna-d sɣur Ṛuma deg wannect-nni n wemkan — Colonia Julia Carthago n Auguste tuɣal d yiwet seg temdinin timeqqranin n Lɣarb aṛumani.
